subject: Supplier onboarding: PO allocation, spend cap and line-item amendments
messages:
From: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@orion-analytics.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts-payable@orion-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps for onboarding + spend cap guidance

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get Orion set up as a vendor. We completed the vendor onboarding PDF (attached) and have two quick follow-ups before we can accept a PO: 

1) Line-item breakdown: The SOW references two product SKUs (Realtime Inference and Batch Embeddings) but the onboarding form shows them merged under a single line-item. Can you confirm whether Redwood requires separate PO line-items (we have internal reporting that needs SKU-level granularity)?

2) Spend cap: Our procurement team wants to set an initial spend cap to avoid overages during the first 30 days. They suggested a $25k monthly cap with automated notification when usage reaches 80%. Is that acceptable, and will Redwood issue an initial PO number tied to that cap?

Attached: orion_onboarding_form_filled.pdf, SOW_Orion_2026-10_signed.pdf

If you want, I can loop in our AP lead to accelerate the PO issuance once we align on the line-items.

Best,
Sofia Ruiz
Vendor Operations Lead | Orion Analytics
sofia.ruiz@orion-analytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@orion-analytics.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, accounts-payable@orion-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps for onboarding + spend cap guidance

Sofia — thanks for the packet and the clear asks. Short answers up front:

- SKU-level line-items: yes, we can issue the PO with separate line-items for Realtime Inference and Batch Embeddings. Please confirm the exact descriptions and unit counts you want on each line (we will mirror those on our PO).
- Spend cap and notifications: we can set an initial not-to-exceed (NTE) monthly cap at $25,000 and configure a notification at 80%. That will be enforced on the Redwood billing side and reflected in the PO notes.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Sofia: please reply with the preferred line-item text and monthly unit estimate for each SKU.
2) Laura (cc'd, Procurement): once Sofia confirms, please draft the PO with NTE = $25,000 and the 80% alert instruction, and include the two separate line-items.
3) Ben (cc'd, Legal): if there are any contract-side concerns with the NTE language, flag them here — otherwise we will treat the PO as the governing purchase instrument for deliverables in the SOW.

I'll hold the PO number assignment until Laura confirms the PO draft. Happy to jump on a quick call if needed.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

From: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@orion-analytics.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts-payable@orion-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps for onboarding + spend cap guidance

Aditya — thanks. See the requested line-item text below (we kept descriptions short to align with our AP fields):

- ORN-RI: Real-time inference (up to 1,000 qps), unit = month, est units = 1
- ORN-BE: Batch embeddings (10k queries/month), unit = month, est units = 1

Couple of clarifications / asks from our AP team: 
- Does Redwood require the PO line-item to include the SOW reference number? They prefer SOW# on each line for reconciliation. If so, please include SOW-2026-10 in the description.
- For the spend cap, can the PO explicitly state that charges in excess of $25k require prior written approval from Orion's AP lead?

Also attached is our internal PO template (PDF embedded in the onboarding form) — happy to map your draft into our template before formal issuance.

Best,
Sofia

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@orion-analytics.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, accounts-payable@orion-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: PO 2026-OR-00421 issued / NTE $25,000 / line-item update

Hi Sofia — looping back with the PO details per your requested line-items. Apologies for the short delay; wanted to confirm language with Legal.

Key points: 
- PO number: 2026-OR-00421 (attached as a PDF export).
- NTE (monthly): $25,000. The PO includes this as a not-to-exceed clause and an instruction that any charges exceeding the cap require prior written approval from an authorized Orion AP contact (we inserted a placeholder for the AP lead name; please confirm and we'll update).
- Line-items (exact text on the PO):
    1) SOW-2026-10 — ORN-RI — Real-time inference (up to 1,000 qps) — unit: month — qty: 1 — unit price: $12,500
    2) SOW-2026-10 — ORN-BE — Batch embeddings (10k queries/month) — unit: month — qty: 1 — unit price: $10,000
    3) PO and platform admin fee (one-time) — unit: each — qty: 1 — unit price: $2,500

Total monthly NTE = $25,000. We also configured an automated 80% alert to both aditya.rao@redwood.ai and accounts-payable@orion-analytics.com.

Next steps for you: 
- Confirm the AP lead name to populate the PO approval clause.
- If you want the PO mirrored into your template, send your template and I will map fields.

Attachments: PO_2026-OR-00421.pdf (signed by Redwood Procurement), copy of SOW for reference.

Thanks — welcome aboard. If Orion's AP needs the PO delivered via a portal or an EDI feed, let me know and we'll coordinate support.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
